understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'; levels had to be completed sequentially, and all goals needed to be occupied simultaneously for a win.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved on a 3-pixel-per-cell grid using directional actions, while walls could block movement and adjacent pushable blocks could be moved along with a piece. CLICK selected a piece using its pixel/grid position, allowing control to switch between pieces. Movement-blocked hints were not always definitive, so actions had to be tested; inefficiently switching pieces consumed the finite step budget.
